title: Conversion-census row
description: Shape of one row in coordinator-claude's conversion census — the per-step classification of converting a skill into a computed skill. Coordinator-claude owns the procedure and tooling that produces rows; this schema defines only the shape a producing row must conform to, so claude-klabauter's compute-layer scaffolder can read a conforming census and know what to generate versus stub, without further co-design on the claude-klabauter side. Spec: coordinator_core/contract/conversion-census-producer-contract.md.

step_id.description: Stable identity of the conversion step this row classifies, scoped to one skill's conversion procedure. Not a cross-skill join key — see contract § 2.

classification.description: MECHANICAL: fully generatable by the scaffolder. JUDGMENT: fully author-authored; the scaffolder emits a stub. MIXED: the step forcibly splits into a mechanical part and a judgment part — see mechanical_part / judgment_part, both required when classification is MIXED (contract § 2.2).

mechanical_part.description: The generatable portion of a MIXED step. Required, and only meaningful, when classification is MIXED — see the mixed-split conditional in § 3.

judgment_part.description: The author-authored portion of a MIXED step. Required, and only meaningful, when classification is MIXED — see the mixed-split conditional in § 3.

notes.description: Optional free-text rationale for the classification. Not consumed structurally by the scaffolder.
